scientific_integrity: The result supplies an all-parameter constructive proof and a separate trajectory lower bound. A standard-library verifier reproduces finite cases; finite checks are not substituted for the proof. No claim to exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact shortest legal reset length proved only for even n>=4, maximum rotation-run length two, standard binary Cerny automaton. Odd n, other constraints, and number of optimal words are not claimed. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Exact bounded-rotation reset threshold for even Černý automata
